hook: Nothing is wasted: every unit you lose or bury feeds the Compost, and your Fruit units grow from it overnight.
loop: Bury cheap units in the shop and let others die fighting.
Each death adds its printed stats to your Compost pile.
Start of Turn: every Fruit unit permanently gains a quarter of it.

growth.line: Every Start of Turn, each Fruit gains a quarter of what died; more Fruit, faster growth.

feel.early: Thin bodies; early losses are cheap and feed you.
feel.mid: Thin until Sealbearer and the Tier 4 multipliers arrive.
feel.late: Bootlace's Fruit network and Mourner make huge permanent growth.

stars.why: Fruit for her whole touching run; your burials keep cutting it.
Kills her neighbours at Start of Combat, firing every death payoff.
Writes each fight death into the Compost twice, shrinking as he does.

builds.name: The Wake
builds.line: Bury cheap units each turn; Sexton, Ludwig and Mourner cash in.

builds.name: The Burst
builds.line: Max fight deaths with puffballs, Amanita and Old Fingers; Puffwell cashes out.

builds.name: The Network
builds.line: Fewer deaths, more mouths: Sealbearer and Bootlace put Fruit everywhere.

liked: Bootlace's run, cut by your own burials, makes placement the skill test.
One shared pile with three levers: more deaths, bigger entries, more Fruit.
worries: Watch: golden Mourner keeps the whole pile, so growth turns quadratic.
Watch: Sealbearers plus Bootlace stack four uncapped Fruit on one carry.
verdict: Rated 7 fun and 6 distinct, ranked first of its seed's three; for players who love sacrifice combos and board puzzles.
